pages.text: The stratosphere is a world of its own above the overworld: black sky and stars, the huge Earth below across the horizon, the same sun, moon, day and night. You cannot fly up alone: ride a flying unit (or play as one, or sit in a transport) above height 300 and you arrive in the stratosphere over the same place. Whatever falls below its floor drops back into the overworld high over the same place; a player falls slowly for 30 seconds.

High in the stratosphere above the base hangs the battlecruiser Hyperion: a hull with a hammer nose, a bridge, turrets and engines, two decks of cabins and passages, a hangar, an engine room with the reactor core and a hold of chests. Destroy the base's main building: a portal to the ship opens where it stood (the portal hall under the base wakes too); kill the guards round it and step in.
